what: Transcription of the PETROLEUM REFINERIES section of the U.S. DOE Hurricane Harvey event reports, Updates #1 to #22: counts and combined capacities exactly as printed. The reports do not name refineries.
notes: Counts for Updates #1 to #9 are the sum of the regional counts in the sentence; the report does not print the total.
asOfUtc converts the section's 'As of' time from EDT (UTC-4).
Update #4's sentence about reduced rates is cut off in the PDF itself.

reports.title: Hurricane Harvey Event Report (Update #1)
reports.summaryQuote: As of 08:00 AM EDT, August 26, all six refineries in the Corpus Christi area have been or were in the process of shutting down, according to public reports. These refineries have a combined refining capacity of 924,720 b/d, equal to 18.4% of total Gulf Coast refining capacity. In addition, one refinery in the Houston/Galveston region area was operating at reduced rates.
